about_the_game:
Smith’s Chronicles is a cozy blacksmith life sim about forging tools, fulfilling requests, and rebuilding a quiet town through craftsmanship. Step into the boots of a young smith who settles back to their hometown and helps bring it back to life. Mine ore, collect various materials, and manage your growing workshop. Every item you craft helps your neighbors, strengthens relationships, and unlocks new opportunities in the world around you.

RESTORE GRANDALL, HOME FOR ALL RACES

Once a thriving town, Grandall is now a quiet and forgotten place. But there's hope in rebuilding. As you explore, you'll encounter refugees seeking shelter and a fresh start. By helping them and bringing them back to Grandall, you breathe new life into the town. Each person you welcome will restore a piece of what was lost, unlocking new services and upgrades. Form meaningful bonds and transform Grandall from a quiet remnant into a lively town once again.

CRAFT TO REBUILD

After graduating from the academy, a letter from the mayor of Grandall arrives, asking for your help. The once-lively village has fallen quiet, and the local forge sits untouched. With few people left and even fewer resources, you take up the forge not just to craft, but to help Grandall thrive again. It’s not just a business, it’s a chance to build something meaningful.

FEATURES

FORGE STUFF. SELL STUFF.

Run your blacksmith shop: Display crafted items in your shop, and sell to customers. Higher-quality materials lead to better items and higher selling prices.

Shop Upgrade: Upgrade counters, shelves, and expand the shop to sell more items and help Grandall flourish again.

DECORATE YOUR SPACE

Make your space feel like home: Decorate your shop and living space, and make your smithy feel uniquely yours.

Craft and decorate: Crafted items can be used as decoration and displayed in your space.

QUEST

Your Journey, One Task at a Time: Take on main story quests, relationship events, and daily tasks from the town quest board. Quests reward you with gold, resources, and deeper bonds with the villagers. 

UNLOCK STORIES THROUGH CONNECTION

Build Bonds with Town Folks: Spend time with the town folks and grow your connection one heart at a time.

Unlock Heartfelt Quests:  Discover personal stories as you deepen your bond with each character.

CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION

Create your look: Select from various hair, clothing, and accessory options to personalize your character.

COOKING

Craft comforting dishes: Turn simple ingredients into warm meals in your cozy kitchen. Discover more than 30 types of dishes.

Food with Powerful Effects: Meals restore stamina and grant useful buffs to improve gathering and increase chances of finding rare materials
